content.title: FAG 6201-2RS Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 12x32x10mm, Rubber Sealed, Steel Cage
content.short_description: FAG 6201-2RS single-row deep groove ball bearing with 2RS rubber seals on both sides, 12mm bore, 32mm OD, 10mm width, steel cage.
content.long_description:
The FAG 6201-2RS is a single-row deep groove ball bearing sized 12mm bore x 32mm outer diameter x 10mm width. It uses a 2RS rubber seal configuration on both faces to retain lubricant and exclude contaminants such as dust and moisture from the raceway. The cage is steel construction, guiding the ball complement between the inner and outer rings.

Dynamic load rating (C) is 6.8 kN, indicating the radial load capacity under rotating conditions for standard fatigue life calculations. Maximum operating temperature is rated at 120°C, which should be checked against the seal material limits and application duty cycle when specifying for continuous-run equipment.

This bearing size and configuration is common in general industrial rotating equipment, small motors, pumps, and gearboxes where a sealed, low-maintenance bearing is required. Confirm shaft and housing fit tolerances, radial load requirements, and ambient temperature against the listed specifications before installation.
